headline: A 2022 executive order on managing the nation's forests and supporting the communities and local economies tied to them.
what_it_does: This executive order directs federal action related to the nation's forests. Its title says it aims to strengthen forests along with the communities and local economies that depend on them. No summary was provided, so the specific actions and rules it sets cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that manage forest land
who_it_affects.how: They are likely the main agencies directed to carry out the order, though the specific tasks are not described in the available material.

who_it_affects.group: People living in or near forested areas
who_it_affects.how: The title names local communities as a focus, but the available material does not say how they would be affected.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 22, 2022; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
